name: mindmaps
description: A spatial surface for thinking, readable and writable by your AI agents over MCP. Self-hosted on your own Cloudflare account.

scripts.build: npm --prefix web ci && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.ci:typecheck: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:e2e

DB.description: Your database: every mindmap, card and link. Lives in your account.

IMAGES.description: Storage for pasted images and uploaded files. Lives in your account.

ARTEFACTS.description: Storage for sheets, docs and decks. Same bucket as IMAGES.

AI.description: Workers AI, used to search your cards by meaning. Free tier is plenty.

VECTORS.description: Search index for meaning-based recall. Created for you.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional. Leave blank: email and password sign-in works without it.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional. Leave blank unless you set up Google sign-in.
